definitions.definition: 本法所稱人工智慧，指具自主運行能力之系統，該系統透過輸入或感測，經由機器學習及演算法，可為明確或隱含之目標實現預測、內容、建議或決策等影響實體或虛擬環境之產出。
definitions.english: Artificial intelligence as referred to in this Act means a system having the capability of autonomous operation which, through input or sensing and by means of machine learning and algorithms, can realize, for explicit or implicit objectives, outputs such as predictions, content, recommendations or decisions that influence physical or virtual environments.

note: Quoted from the National Science and Technology Council's law database page of the Artificial Intelligence Basic Act (人工智慧基本法, promulgated 民國 115 年 01 月 14 日 by order 華總一義字第11500001671號). The Act defines 'artificial intelligence' (人工智慧) itself as a system, so the item is in the artificial intelligence group; it has no separate definition of an AI system. Article 5 refers to AI products or systems that the central competent authority, in consultation with the Ministry of Digital Affairs, determines to be high-risk applications (高風險應用), and Article 17 to high-risk AI applications (高風險人工智慧之應用); neither defines a high-risk AI system. The issuer's English translation is not among the stored files (secondary.html is the English list page with the title only, and is stale), so the English rendering is the agent's. document-1.pdf is the law database's user manual, not the Act.
